1286|ed056522.name: Edna Mullby
1286|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1301|fe52f4ea.name: Julia Gallina
1301|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1305|9f005af4.name: Jarel Moor
1305|9f005af4.text: Take my advice, don't sit close to the shadows.

1339|877c4b1d.name: Mayda Thane
1339|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

203478|01ff6526.name: Stuart
203478|01ff6526.text: Oy, you there! *hic* You got some kinda problem pal?

5595|02e0b463.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|02e0b463.text:
Looking to take a ride on a gryphon, now are ye?  Gryth Thurden is the one ye'll want to be seeing about that.  

Ye can find him on the eastern side of The Great Forge in the middle of Ironforge.

68|fccc769b.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|fccc769b.text:
If you are looking to become a great cook, venture over to the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town and talk to Stephen Ryback. That man knows how to cook up a rack of ribs like no other.

Man... now you got me hungry for some of his famous ribs. Don't count on him teaching you that recipe though!

727|3d785b33.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|3d785b33.text: Ye won't find a gryphon master just anywhere around Dun Morogh, lad.  Ye're going to have to go to Ironforge if ye want to take a gryphon somewhere.

116-complete.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-complete.text:
A job well done, $N!  I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor.  But my patrons will be happy once again! 

My wife is quite a seamstress.  Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
116-complete.title: Dry Times

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-complete.text:
I do say, this is not good at all.  I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire.  What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people?  Bah, I should not ponder aloud.

Here, messenger.  Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township.  I might call upon you again.
144-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the $r lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery
